title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The second ICSP programme component in Uganda focuses on food systems and will be implemented in the West Nile and Teso sub-regions. It will target 2,000 households (12,000 beneficiaries). Training will be delivered on Climate Smart Agriculture and good Agronomic Practices, block farms will be established and maintained, and farmer groups will be formed. Subsidised agricultural inputs will be provided, seed fairs will be held, and regular field visits conducted by agricultural extension workers. Training will be delivered on value addition, food preservation and agro-processing for selected value chains. Women and youth will be specifically targeted for the establishment ofhome gardens and trained on safe food handling techniques and improved storage practices. Awareness will be raised in the wider community of good hygiene and sanitation practices. Waste management systems will be put in place to ensure safe disposal of human waste and recycling of agricultural waste for manure and animal fodder.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2: Equitable and inclusive food systems to support availability, access and consumption of safe nutritious food. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Activities to promote increased uptake of nutritious diets
